title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator - School Trust
Location: Central Trust Office, with travel to schools within the Trust
We are looking for a highly organised and proactive HR Administrator to join our friendly and supportive School Trust team. Based primarily at our central office, you will provide effective HR and administrative support across the Trust, with travel to a couple of our schools as required.
This is a varied role that would suit someone who enjoys working with people, is confident handling confidential information and has excellent attention to detail. There will also be some involvement in finance and payroll administration, although previous finance experience is not essential as training and support can be provided.
This is a temporary role working 8-4 Monday - Thursday and 8-3:30 on a Friday. To start January 2027 on a temporary basis. There may be the option of a permanent position but that is not guaranteed.
Key responsibilities
Your day-to-day duties will include:
Providing general administrative support to the HR function and schools across the Trust
Maintaining accurate and up-to-date employee records and HR systems
Supporting the recruitment process, including preparing adverts, arranging interviews and completing pre-employment checks
Assisting with new starter and leaver processes
Preparing HR documentation, letters and contracts
Supporting managers and staff with general HR queries
Monitoring and maintaining records relating to sickness absence, annual leave and other employee information
Assisting with payroll administration and providing relevant information to the payroll team
Supporting basic finance administration, such as processing invoices, checking information and maintaining records
Producing reports and maintaining accurate spreadsheets and databases
Ensuring HR processes and documentation are completed accurately and on time
Liaising with staff, school leaders and external providers when required
Providing administrative support for meetings, training and other HR-related activities
Travelling occasionally to other schools within the Trust to provide on-site support
About you
We are looking for someone who is:
Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel
Able to manage confidential and sensitive information appropriately
A strong communicator who is comfortable dealing with staff at all levels
Able to prioritise and manage a varied workload
Reliable, professional and able to work independently as well as part of a team
Previous HR or school administration experience would be advantageous, but is not essential
Some experience of finance or payroll administration would be beneficial, but is not essential
Aspire People Limited provides services as an Education Agency and an Education Employment Business. Aspire People is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of pupils and expects every candidate to share this commitment. Placements are subject, to appropriate Child Protection screening, including checks with former employers and the Disclosure and Barring Checks.

title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Business Support Administrator
Leicester City Centre
£26,100 per annum

Fixed term contract until August 2027
37.5 hours per week - Office based

SF Recruitment is recruiting for an HR Business Support Administrator to join an established business in Leicester City Centre.

This is a great opportunity for someone with HR administration experience, or a strong administrator looking to move into HR. You'll join a busy shared services team, supporting day to day HR administration and helping ensure employee records, documentation and systems are accurate and up to date.

The role will include:
- Preparing contracts and letters relating to changes throughout the employee lifecycle.
- Updating and maintaining employee information on the HR system.
- Responding to queries through a central inbox and workload management tool.
- Providing administrative support to HR Advisors and the wider team.
- Checking employee documentation and data for accuracy.
- Supporting ad hoc projects and general administration as required.

We're looking for someone who:
- Has experience within a busy HR or administration role.
- Is organised and comfortable managing changing priorities.
- Has excellent attention to detail and takes pride in accurate work.
- Communicates confidently with colleagues at all levels.
- Brings a positive, proactive approach and enjoys working as part of a team.

Experience using Workday, ServiceNow, Airtable or Benefex would be an advantage, although this is not essential.

Benefits include:
- 25 days' holiday, increasing with service up to 30 days.
- Pension scheme and life cover.
- Shopping and dining discounts.
- Access to an Employee Assistance Programme.

If you're looking for your next administration opportunity and would enjoy supporting a busy HR team, apply today or contact Natalie at (url removed) for more information.

title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Assistant

26-30k

Looking for your next step within HR?

This could be a great opportunity to step into a varied position where you'll work with businesses across a range of industries, helping them stay compliant and up to date with their HR documentation.

We're looking for someone with practical HR knowledge, strong communication skills and the confidence to build relationships with clients.

YOU?

title: HR Coordinator
description:
HR Coordinator (M/F/D)
Behind a positive employee experience is a HR team that gets the details right, provides clear support and makes things straightforward for employees and managers.
We're looking for an experienced People and Culture (HR) Coordinator to join our team and provide high-quality HR coordination and support across the employee lifecycle. You'll be a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, providing guidance on day-to-day HR processes and ensuring key activities are coordinated accurately, professionally and with care. From creating a seamless onboarding experience to supporting changes throughout employment, you'll play an important role in delivering an HR service that is responsive, reliable and people-focused.
What you'll be handling:
- Creating a professional and welcoming onboarding experience for new colleagues.
- Acting as an initial point of contact for employee and manager HR queries, ensuring they are directed to the appropriate HR advisor for support.
- Coordinating employee documentation and changes throughout the employee lifecycle.
- Maintaining accurate, confidential and up-to-date employee information.
- Supporting absence, family leave and other HR processes.
- Coordinating offboarding activities with care and attention to detail.
- Building effective working relationships across People and Culture and the wider business.
- Identifying opportunities to make our HR processes more efficient and improve the service we provide.

What you'll need:
You'll bring experience in administration or coordination, together with a strong understanding of what good HR support looks like. You'll be organised and dependable, with the ability to balance competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail. You'll communicate confidently with employees and managers at different levels and understand the discretion and professionalism required when handling sensitive and confidential information.
You'll be comfortable working with HR systems and digital tools, adaptable when priorities change and interested in finding practical ways to improve how things are done. Most importantly, you'll bring a collaborative approach, sound judgement and a genuine commitment to providing a high-quality HR service.
If you're looking for a varied HR role where you can use your experience, broaden your knowledge and make a valued contribution to the employee experience, we'd love to hear from you.
What you'll receive:
At TGW Northern Europe, we want you to thrive both at work and beyond. That's why we offer a range of benefits designed to support your career, health and wellbeing:
- Ongoing learning and development to help you grow your career
- 25 days' annual leave
- A generous pension scheme
- Medicash health cash plan, including support with dental, optical and therapy costs
- Free access to our onsite gym, including weekly classes

title: HR Officer

title: Recruitment Assistant
description:
Recruitment Assistant

Shift Pattern: Monday-Friday, 40 Hours per week

Location: Hybrid, Barrow Upon Soar, Glenfield, Leicester (LE3), Home based

Salary: Negotiable, dependant on skills and experience

The Role

We are looking for a Recruitment Assistant to provide an end-to-end recruitment service to the business, supporting the Recruiter to advise, assist and manage recruitment needs. Responsible for providing excellent customer service to both internal and external customers offering timely and accurate recruitment support ensuring all tasks are carried out to the highest standards ensuring accuracy of information.

Your main responsibilities will include:
- Manage candidate responses/applications received and ensure candidate applications are processed efficiently.
- Qualify, shortlist and present suitable candidates against defined job vacancies.
- Conduct telephone interviews with candidates to ensure suitability against essential vacancy criteria, whilst delivering a first-class candidate experience.
- Proactive and driven to contact candidates directly about job opportunities.
- Assist in the recruitment and selection processes by effectively liaising with the candidates and internal teams.
- Be proactive and committed to building and maintaining strong relationships with both candidates and hiring teams, to instil trust and confidence and ensure a positive experience through the full recruitment process.
- Arrange interviews with hiring managers.
- Arrange candidate interviews which could either be face-to-face or video interviews.
- Conduct right to work checks for potential new hires.
- Support the wider HR team as and when required.

About Us

At Geary s Bakeries, we re on a crusade to make proper bread more accessible to more people. We re passionate about re-imagining the way Great Britain thinks about their everyday loaf. This passion is at the heart of everything we do, and have done, since 1906.

We are born and bread in Leicestershire and proud of our long-standing heritage. Today, we operate from three sites on a 24/7 operation. We re made up of towards 900 people: a friendly, diverse and outgoing team, passionate about making a difference to the bakery industry.

The business has grown rapidly from £5m in annual sales to £125m+ in the last 15 years with strong and consistent profitability. We have an ambition to increase sales to more than £200m+ in the next 3- 5 years. A clear Vision and Strategy has been articulated, and this is being backed with major capital investment and a renewal and upgrading of the people, processes, and systems.

Our brilliant benefits include free delicious bread, BUPA Cashback Plan, Death In Service, a Cycle to Work scheme and a chance to win a £10k worth prizes annually! Plus, if you refer a friend to join our team, you could earn up to £500!

About You

At Geary s, we look for people who show up every day to do their best. We re a passionate, friendly team and look for the same qualities in our new recruits. We firmly believe your attitude and approach is just as important (if not, more so) than the skills and experience on your CV.

What we re looking for:
- Self-motivated, tenacious and resilient
- Driven and determined to achieve targets and objectives
- Attention to detail and accuracy
- Customer focused approach
- Demonstrable questioning and listening skills
- Highly structured and independent
- Happy to work autonomously.
- Approachable and confident to handle sensitive and confidential subjects
- Ability to remain calm and positive under pressure

Skills and Experience
- Fast paced customer service sales experience
- Administration experience within a sales environment
- Recruitment resourcing experience ideally, although not essential
- Experience in FMCG ideally, although not essential

Please submit a CV in application. No agencies.

If you have not heard from us within seven days, unfortunately you have not been successful on this occasion, but we wish you every success in your search for a new position.

All applicants must have the right to work in the UK, at point of interview, and for the tenure of employment contract. As part of the recruitment process, you will be asked to provide documented evidence of your eligibility to work in the UK.

title: Recruitment Coordinator
description:
Recruitment Coordinator

Syston

The opportunity to start a career in recruitment, learn from some of the best in the business and work with an exciting mix of clients and brands.
- Are you organised, enthusiastic and naturally good with people, with an eye for detail and a desire to learn?
- Would you love a varied role where no two days are quite the same, working across different industries and exciting opportunities?
- Are you looking for a company where you can develop your skills, take on new challenges and build a long-term career?

The Company:

At ER Recruitment, connecting people is in our DNA. We're an established, award-winning recruitment consultancy with a reputation for building genuine relationships and making a positive difference to the businesses and people we work with.

Led by Eileen Perry MBE DL, who brings over 30 years of recruitment industry experience, our team works with an exciting portfolio of businesses, from ambitious local companies to some of the UK's most recognised brands.

We're passionate about what we do, proud of the relationships we've built and believe recruitment should be about quality, not just quantity.

We're now looking for a Recruitment Coordinator to join Team Purple and become an important part of our growing business.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who wants to get into recruitment. You'll gain exposure to all aspects of the recruitment process, support a variety of exciting assignments and learn from an experienced team who are genuinely invested in helping you develop.

Role & Responsibilities of the Recruitment Coordinator:
- Supporting the team throughout the recruitment process, from advertising vacancies and reviewing applications through to candidate management and placement.
- Coordinating interviews, arranging diaries and maintaining communication with candidates and clients.
- Preparing job adverts, candidate profiles, presentations and other recruitment documentation.
- Supporting candidate sourcing, database management and maintaining accurate records across our recruitment systems.
- Getting involved in marketing and social media activity, helping create engaging content and promote our brand.
- Providing general administrative and operational support to ensure the smooth running of the business.
- Building your recruitment knowledge and gradually taking on more responsibility as your skills and confidence develop.

About You as the Recruitment Coordinator:
- Organised, proactive and someone who takes pride in getting the details right.
- A confident communicator who enjoys interacting with different people and building relationships.
- Comfortable using Microsoft Office and keen to learn new systems and technology.
- A positive, adaptable team player who enjoys variety and is happy to get stuck in.
- Interested in recruitment, people and business, with a genuine desire to develop a career in the industry.
- Previous administration, customer service, marketing or office experience would be beneficial, but attitude, enthusiasm and willingness to learn are just as important.

Additional Benefits:
- The opportunity to learn from an experienced and well-connected recruitment team, including over 30 years of industry knowledge at leadership level.
- Exposure to a diverse range of roles, sectors, clients and recognised brands.
- Genuine opportunities for career development and progression as the business grows.
- A friendly, supportive team environment where your contribution and ideas are valued.

Please note by applying for this role you give consent for ER Recruitment to retain your CV for up to 24 months for the purposes of assisting you to find your next role unless you notify us otherwise.

While we aim to get back to all applicants, if you do not receive a response within 7 working days then unfortunately your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

We are here to help with your career so please send a copy of your CV to us. If you know of anyone else who is looking for their next opportunity, please feel free to refer them to us or pass on our details.

We look forward to hearing from you.
